partners.mechanism_chain: EHHADH (HGNC:3250) —DISRUPTS→ 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA lyase activity (GO:0004123); 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA lyase activity (GO:0004123) —DECREASES→ 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA (CHEBI:15905); 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA (CHEBI:15905) —DECREASES→ 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaric acid (CHEBI:15336); 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaric acid (CHEBI:15336) —LEADS_TO→ Metabolic acidosis (HP:0010977); HMGCL (HGNC:4544) —DISRUPTS→ Ketogenesis (GO:0006093); Ketogenesis (GO:0006093) —LEADS_TO→ Hypoketotic hypoglycemia (HP:0012240). Loss of function in EHHADH (Disease A) impairs the breakdown of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA, leading to accumulation of upstream metabolites and potentially metabolic acidosis. Similarly, loss of function in HMGCL (Disease B) disrupts ketogenesis, a downstream pathway utilizing 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA, resulting in hypoketotic hypoglycemia. **How to falsify it:** Identification of distinct molecular pathways or complete lack of overlap in affected metabolites between the two diseases in unbiased metabolomic studies. _(variant: rs74473068)_
